subject: https://github.com/the-omega-institute/trureturing
summary: A nilpotent plane operation shows why being killed is weaker than splitting off. Common kernels and images explain the two-rank loss, tensor decay and the exact scope of the public Lean theorem.
summary_zh: 从平面上的幂零操作出发，区分被消掉与独立拆出，用共同核、共同像解释两份秩的代价、张量衰减与公开 Lean 定理的准确范围。
title: From a common zero space to an independent summand
title_zh: 从共同零空间到独立直和项
